magnesium_structure_retrieval_subtask_me.name: Magnesium Structure Retrieval for Melting
magnesium_structure_retrieval_subtask_me.description: Retrieve structure of Magnesium and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

magnesium_potential_file_subtask_melting.name: Magnesium Potential File for Melting
magnesium_potential_file_subtask_melting.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Magnesium for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting.name: Magnesium NVT Equilibration for melting
magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Magnesium structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, equilibrate the system under NVT conditions with the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in x, y and z direction. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the final density in g/cm^3.
magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting.submission_format: {"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

magnesium_npt_subtask_melting.name: Magnesium NPT Equilibration for melting
magnesium_npt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible nvt equilibrated Magnesium structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the system under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the final density in gm/cm^3.
magnesium_npt_subtask_melting.submission_format: {"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

magnesium_melting_npt_subtask_melting.name: Magnesium NPT Melting
magnesium_melting_npt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible npt equilibrated Magnesium structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the melting of the equilibrated system by heating it under NPT where the temperature is gradually increased to induce melting. Report the final density in g/cm^3.
